about_short_description.short_description: Eatr simplifies your meals with bespoke meal planning for every taste and goal.

product.name: Personalized Meal Planning Service
product.description: A service that provides custom weekly meal plans tailored to individual dietary goals, preferences, and schedules.

product.name: Meal and Nutrition Tracking
product.description: A feature that allows users to log meals, track calorie intake, and monitor nutritional goals.

product.name: Recipe Database
product.description: A comprehensive collection of over 2,000 recipes designed to support various dietary needs and preferences.

product.name: Special Diet Guidance
product.description: Expert guidance and resources for managing specific dietary needs like diabetes, gluten-free, low-carb, and anti-inflammatory diets.

product.name: Nutrition and Healthy Lifestyle Content
product.description: Educational articles and guides on healthy eating, meal planning, and lifestyle habits to support overall well-being.
